title: Order Answer
description: The Order Answer the integration gives a Partner in the response to a Partner Order request (UC-001 step 8, A3 to A8). Trailhead Gear owns it (UC-001 BR-011). A refused request (UC-001 A1, A2) gets no Order Answer.

orderNumber.description: Order Number of the Partner Order, as the Partner sent it. Absent when the request cannot be read as a Partner Order (UC-001 A3).

result.description: `accepted` only after the Accepted Order is recorded (UC-001 BR-003); `rejected` with every Rejection Reason (UC-001 BR-004); `temporarily-unavailable` during a Catalog Outage or while the Order Database is unavailable, so that the Partner resends (UC-001 BR-009).

rejectionReasons.description: Every Rejection Reason, in the order of the Order Checks (UC-001 BR-004); only when `result` is `rejected`.
